caption: The drawing depicts two elongated metal objects positioned diagonally on a plain, light beige background. Each object is brown in color, displaying a rusty or aged appearance. The object on the left is a narrow rod with a slight curvature at the top end and a loop at the bottom end. The object on the right is a broader, flat strip of metal with five circular holes spaced along its length; one end of this strip is curled into a loop and the opposite end is rounded with a large hole. Both objects cast subtle shadows, suggesting a light source from the upper left. The composition is simple, with the objects arranged parallel to each other, occupying the majority of the drawing area.
title: Strap Hinges
